input: /home/eval/etl is a git repo. `scripts/process.sh SHARD` sums the amount column of data/SHARD.csv into out/SHARD.sum. Run it for the shards listed in SHARDS concurrently as background jobs, then wait for each job and write its exit status to out/status.txt, one line per shard in SHARDS order, formatted `SHARD EXIT_CODE`. One shard will fail: find the bad input row it reports and delete that row from the data file, re-run just that shard, then run `make report`. Commit the data fix and out/ with a message starting with `data:`.

tool_calls:
cd /home/eval/etl
cat Makefile
echo "=== SHARDS ==="
cat SHARDS
echo "=== scripts/process.sh ==="
cat scripts/process.sh

cd /home/eval/etl
mkdir -p out
declare -A pids
shards=()
while read -r shard; do
  [ -z "$shard" ] && continue
  shards+=("$shard")
  scripts/process.sh "$shard" &
  pids["$shard"]=$!
done < SHARDS

: > out/status.txt
for shard in "${shards[@]}"; do
  pid="${pids[$shard]}"
  wait "$pid"
  status=$?
  echo "$shard $status" >> out/status.txt
done

#!/bin/bash
# Combine out/*.sum (every shard in SHARDS must be present) into out/report.txt
total=0
: > out/report.txt
while read -r shard; do
  [ -f "out/$shard.sum" ] || { echo "missing out/$shard.sum"; exit 1; }
  v=$(cat "out/$shard.sum")
  echo "$shard $v" >> out/report.txt
  total=$((total + v))
done < SHARDS
echo "total $total" >> out/report.txt
cat out/report.txt
